# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

July 06, 2026

communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.

tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Questions, answered

Who is Aidy for?

Aidy is for anyone living with Inflammatory Bowel Disease who wants more control over their
condition and life!

Why do people use Aidy?

People use Aidy to track their condition, find and avoid their triggers, learn about the disease,
and share data with their doctor.

Is my data safe?

Absolutely. We take great care to ensure your data is encrypted and safe. We don't sell your data
and don't run any ads.

Is Aidy free?

Aidy is free to use; we don't have paid user subscriptions because we believe this service should be
accessible to everyone. We work with health plans, employers, and researchers to generate revenue.

Does Aidy support other conditions?

Not yet, today Aidy is focused entirely on Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis. Support for other
conditions may come in the future.

# Digest. Absorb. Nourish.

**Patients living with serious medical conditions due to rare diseases** often require enteral
feeding for nutrition. Many of these patients struggle with digesting fat, essential for growth,
immunity, and organ function. Unable to get the full nutritional benefits from enteral feeding,
these patients may experience poor outcomes and significant health consequences as a result.

Alcresta develops rare disease, enzyme-based products helping to address fat malabsorption (often
due to exocrine pancreatic insufficiency) in patients who are enterally fed at home or in the
hospital. Our RELiZORB^{®} cartridge contains iLipase^{®}, a patented microbead/enzyme technology
that breaks down fat for easy ingestion and optimal absorption.

[Our Science][27]

[RELiZORB logo]
[RELiZORB cartridge]

**The first and only enzyme product for use in enteral feeding. **RELiZORB is a digestive enzyme
cartridge designed to mimic the function of pancreatic lipase. RELiZORB helps children and adults on
enteral tube feeding who have trouble breaking down and absorbing fats due to cystic fibrosis, short
bowel syndrome, pancreatitis, digestive cancers, and other rare diseases.

[RELiZORB][28]

### RELiZORB clinical trials now enrolling patients

**Short bowel syndrome (SBS)**
* 90 day, Phase 3, open labeled exploratory study of RELiZORB. To learn more,
  visit [ClinicalTrials.gov, trial NCT03530852][29]
* 90 day observational study as an extension to the Phase 3, open labeled exploratory study of
  RELiZORB. To learn more, visit [ClinicalTrials.gov, trial NCT05635747][30]

Pancreatitis
* A Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating the Efficacy of Immobilized Lipase (RELiZORB) During
  Enteral Nutrition in Patients with Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency Secondary to Acute
  Pancreatitis. To learn more, visit [ClinicalTrials.gov, trial NCT06691893][31]
* Open-label, Multicenter, Phase IV, Study Evaluating RELiZORB Use for the Treatment of Feeding
  Intolerance in Adults With Moderate to Severe Acute Pancreatitis. To learn more, visit
  [ClinicalTrials.gov, trial NCT07583342][32]

Critical care
* A Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Single-Center Proof of Concept Prospective Study Evaluating
  the Utility of RELiZORB for the Treatment of Feeding Intolerance in Critically Ill Adults with
  Multi-Organ Failure. To learn more, visit [ClinicalTrials.gov, trial NCT05710315][33]

### RELiZORB Pediatric Gastrointestinal Patient Registry  ENROLLMENT COMPLETE

Alcresta is conducting a pediatric direct-to-patient prospective observational data registry. [Learn
more][34].

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

[ EXPLORE THE PIPELINE ][76]

## Find Care Near You

## Christian Rekindles Her Joy

### SLP, Phoenix, AZ

After years in public schools, Christian transitioned to home health to reconnect with her passion
for speech therapy. With less paperwork, a more flexible schedule, and meaningful one-on-one time,
she helps kiddos like Chloe thrive using eye gaze technology — all in the comfort of her own home.

[Meet More Caregivers][42]
[Christian rekindles her joy]

Christian M.

Speech-Language Pathologist

Phoenix, AZ

## Sasha’s Rewarding Life

### LPN, Jacksonville, FL

Sasha joined Care Options for Kids looking for a more meaningful, less stressful nursing experience
— and found precisely that. She loves the one-on-one connection with patients, the supportive team,
and the flexibility to balance work and life. Moments like seeing Jesse’s heartfelt smile remind her
she’s exactly where she’s meant to be.

[Meet More Caregivers][43]
[Sasha's rewarding life]

Sasha E.

Licensed Practical Nurse

Jacksonville, FL

## Laura Gets to Play All Day

### DPT, Phoenix, AZ

Laura, a physical therapist, loves that her job feels like play — while making a real impact.
Working with Presley since age three, she’s witnessed incredible progress through home-based therapy
tailored to daily life. Laura enjoys helping kids thrive right where they’re most comfortable.

[Meet More Caregivers][44]
[Laura gets to play all day]

Laura N.

Doctor of Physical Therapy

Phoenix, AZ

## Mary Rose Finds Her Calling

### Assistant Director, RN, Jacksonville, FL

Drawn to Care Options for Kids by a former colleague’s glowing recommendation, Mary Rose found more
than just a job — she found her calling with a supportive, experienced care team. The hands-on
tracheostomy and ventilator training she received gave her the confidence to provide the highest
level of care.

[Meet More Caregivers][45]
[Mary Roses finds her calling]

Assistant Director, RN

Jacksonville, FL

## The Village

### Our Social Network for Families

Say hello to the community you didn’t know you needed — The Village, a social network made just for
families. Now you can meet people who relate to your day-to-day experiences, understand your
struggles, and celebrate your wins. Join our community and start making connections!
[Join The Village][46]

## For Food Allergies

A food allergy is when a person's immune system overreacts to something in a certain food, usually a
protein, thinking it is a threat and causing different reactions.

[ Read More ][81]

## Short Bowel Syndrome (SBS)

Short bowel syndrome describes a group of problems affecting individuals who have lost the use of a
major part of their small intestine.

[ Read More ][82]

## Malabsorption and Other Conditions

Malabsorption means that a child's body has trouble absorbing nutrients from food.

## Your team has ideas,

## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

  straight.

#### Connection Date:

#### Reference Number:

This is the important part. This reference number is the basic identification of your bill that is
just like your account number. You can pay your bill on behalf of this reference number and get
duplicate copy of your bill by providing this reference number etc.

[iesco bill reference number]

#### Dates:

In the top right corner of your bill, you can find reading date, issue date, and due date. These
dates represent when the agent noted your meter reading, when bill was issued and what is the last
date to pay your bill.

#### FPA:

A lot of people ask what is FPA in the electricity bill? FPA stands for Fuel Price Adjustment. This
is a system to adjust electricity fees based on fuel prices fluctuation. The FPA price belongs to
the fuel pricing of rental power companies that generate electricity from Crude Oil etc.

#### TR Surcharge:

T.R is Tariff Rationalization Surcharge. In revised criteria, NEPRA will determine tariff and
Government notify a uniform tariff for all Distribution Companies. This is the difference of NEPRA
and GOP tariff. If difference is positive, it will be payable by GOP as "Subsidy". However in case
of negative difference, the Distribution Company will pay to GOP as "Inter DISCO Tariff
Rationalization Surcharge ( IDTR SUR )".

#### QTR Tariff Adj / DMC

Quarterly tariff adjustment amount that you may see in your bill after every 3 months. This tax
applies to domestic consumers if they cross the limit of 300 units. For commercial and industrial
consumers, this tax applies even if a single unit is consumed.

#### FC Surcharge:

FC stands for Financing Cost. Financing Cost Surcharge was initially decided to be 43 paisa per
unit, to ensure collection of debt servicing of the Power Holding Private Limited.

#### Bill Timing:

Depending on your region, you may receive your bill on different dates of the month. However you can
see bill history to know about your bill reading date, issue date and due date to get idea about the
bill timing.

# MalaCards: The Human Disease Database

**Version 6.1** - June 17, 2026
[Previous version][28]

# The Human Disease Database

MalaCards is a searchable, integrated knowledgebase offering comprehensive, user-friendly
information on human diseases, medical conditions, and disorders. Explore extensive gene-disease
associations, disease mutations, phenotypes, pathways, drugs, and more, seamlessly integrated from
85 curated and computed, trusted web sources. Designed for researchers, clinicians, and students,
MalaCards simplifies access to disease-centric data, modeled on the architecture of the renowned
GeneCards database. Start your journey into cutting-edge disease research today!

MalaCards is a searchable, comprehensive knowledgebase for human diseases, integrating data from 85
trusted sources on genes, symptoms, drugs, mutations, clinical trials and more.

e.g.
* Ovarian Cancer
* Alzheimer's Disease

## Explore a Malady

Examples: Eg:
* Ovarian Cancer
* Alzheimer's Disease

* "calcific tendinitis"
* insulin

## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

## Life-Changing Research

Nemours is leading important pediatric research and clinical trials. We’re preventing and reversing
the course of childhood diseases, improving health care delivery, and keeping children safe and
healthy for generations to come. We partner with renowned medical schools and organizations to find
answers to the most pressing questions in kids’ health. Our discoveries help children in your
community and all over the world.

[Graphic icon of a lightbulb with a brain inside]

[Graphic icon of a microscope]

11 Research Centers

[Graphic icon of DNA]

240+ Clinical Trials Across the U.S.

[Graphic icon of a certificate with an award ribbon]

## Donations and Volunteering

Nemours has set out to change the definition of children’s health. We believe good health goes
beyond great medicine. Good health involves education and access to food and housing. It includes
strong families. It addresses mental wellness, health outcomes, and justice for all. And so much
more. Join us.

# Support. Education. Resources. Advocacy.

United Ostomy Associations of America, Inc. (UOAA) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that
supports, empowers, and advocates for people who have had or who will have ostomy or continent
diversion surgery. Our mission is to promote quality of life for people with ostomies and continent
diversions through information, support, advocacy, and collaboration.

[SUPPORT GROUP FINDER][122] [BECOME A MEMBER][123] [VIRTUAL OSTOMY CLINIC][124]

### **Support**

Find local peer support at one of our 275+ support groups in the U.S., get answers to non-emergency
medical questions through the Virtual Ostomy Clinic or connect with peers through our Facebook
community and online discussion board.

### **Education**

Medically reviewed surgery-specific information. Ostomy pouch management tips, diet & nutrition,
skincare, sexuality, travel tips and more!

### **Resources**

Whether you’re new to the ostomy community or a seasoned person with an ostomy, we offer online
tools and guides to help you throughout your journey.

### **Advocacy**

Join our national advocacy network and take action on issues that affect the quality of life of all
people living with an ostomy or continent diversion in the United States.

## *NEW!* **Your Own Virtual Certified Ostomy Nurse**

Whether it’s a colostomy, ileostomy or urostomy, a new ostomate learning to care for their stoma or
an existing ostomate grappling with new complications, the journey can be overwhelming. UOAA’s
Virtual Ostomy Clinic provided by The Wound Company offers support through telehealth visits and
ongoing touchpoints via texting and emailing to make sure ostomates have the right supplies for
their unique situation and thoroughly understand how to care for their ostomy.

Assess a person’s ostomy in one comprehensive telehealth assessment by Zoom in the beginning of the
30-day period
Assist ostomates and their caregivers in choosing supplies and recommend pouching options that fit
the person’s life

# Support. Education. Resources. Advocacy.

United Ostomy Associations of America, Inc. (UOAA) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that
supports, empowers, and advocates for people who have had or who will have ostomy or continent
diversion surgery. Our mission is to promote quality of life for people with ostomies and continent
diversions through information, support, advocacy, and collaboration.

[SUPPORT GROUP FINDER][122] [BECOME A MEMBER][123] [VIRTUAL OSTOMY CLINIC][124]

### **Support**

Find local peer support at one of our 275+ support groups in the U.S., get answers to non-emergency
medical questions through the Virtual Ostomy Clinic or connect with peers through our Facebook
community and online discussion board.

### **Education**

Medically reviewed surgery-specific information. Ostomy pouch management tips, diet & nutrition,
skincare, sexuality, travel tips and more!

### **Resources**

Whether you’re new to the ostomy community or a seasoned person with an ostomy, we offer online
tools and guides to help you throughout your journey.

### **Advocacy**

Join our national advocacy network and take action on issues that affect the quality of life of all
people living with an ostomy or continent diversion in the United States.

## *NEW!* **Your Own Virtual Certified Ostomy Nurse**

Whether it’s a colostomy, ileostomy or urostomy, a new ostomate learning to care for their stoma or
an existing ostomate grappling with new complications, the journey can be overwhelming. UOAA’s
Virtual Ostomy Clinic provided by The Wound Company offers support through telehealth visits and
ongoing touchpoints via texting and emailing to make sure ostomates have the right supplies for
their unique situation and thoroughly understand how to care for their ostomy.

Assess a person’s ostomy in one comprehensive telehealth assessment by Zoom in the beginning of the
30-day period
Assist ostomates and their caregivers in choosing supplies and recommend pouching options that fit
the person’s life

  ### Allergies
  
  Allergies are an overreaction by your immune system to a substance or food that is not considered
  harmful to most other people. Substances that cause allergies are called allergens or “triggers”.
  
  ][58]

  breath, chest tightness, and coughing.
  
  ][59]

  ][60]

  main types: gestational, type 1, type 2 plus a stage before called pre-diabetes.
  
  ][61]

# Empowering the Short Bowel Syndrome Community

### A trusted global resource for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.

### Welcome to the Short Bowel Syndrome Foundation (SBSF)

Founded in December 2010, the SBSF was created with a single mission: to provide the education,
support, and resources necessary to help you navigate life with Short Bowel Syndrome (SBS).

Whether you are a patient learning to adapt, a caregiver supporting a loved one, or a healthcare
provider seeking clinical insights, you are not alone in this journey. We are here to help you
regain control of your health and improve your quality of life.

### What You Will Find Here
* 🧠 **Comprehensive Education:** Clear, easy-to-understand explanations of the causes, common
  symptoms, and standard treatments for SBS.
* 🩺 **Anatomical Guides:** In-depth breakdowns of the human digestive system and the specific
  surgical procedures associated with SBS.
* 📋 **Practical Resources:** Tools, downloadable materials, and advocacy programs designed to help
  you confidently manage the condition day-to-day.

# Empowering the Short Bowel Syndrome Community

### A trusted global resource for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.

### Welcome to the Short Bowel Syndrome Foundation (SBSF)

Founded in December 2010, the SBSF was created with a single mission: to provide the education,
support, and resources necessary to help you navigate life with Short Bowel Syndrome (SBS).

Whether you are a patient learning to adapt, a caregiver supporting a loved one, or a healthcare
provider seeking clinical insights, you are not alone in this journey. We are here to help you
regain control of your health and improve your quality of life.

### What You Will Find Here
* 🧠 **Comprehensive Education:** Clear, easy-to-understand explanations of the causes, common
  symptoms, and standard treatments for SBS.
* 🩺 **Anatomical Guides:** In-depth breakdowns of the human digestive system and the specific
  surgical procedures associated with SBS.
* 📋 **Practical Resources:** Tools, downloadable materials, and advocacy programs designed to help
  you confidently manage the condition day-to-day.

# YOUR STRENGTH IS INSIDE

Short bowel syndrome (SBS) is the result of a bowel resection, which can be a consequence of a
number of other medical conditions. Your inner strength can help you manage your SBS, and this
website also provides resources to help.

DARIO, LIVING WITH SBS

Short bowel syndrome (SBS) is the result of a bowel resection, which can be a consequence of a
number of other medical conditions. Your inner strength can help you manage your SBS, and this
website also provides resources to help.

[Plate and Cup Graphic]

SBS and Your Diet

There's no single “SBS diet.” Your personal nutritional needs will vary depending on the length and
portion of your remaining bowel. Read about how to help optimize your nutrition and hydration.

[Optimize your SBS diet][49]
[Intestine Icon]

Precursors to SBS

Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis (UC), and other conditions sometimes require bowel resection
surgery, which may lead to SBS. Learn about the most common conditions that can lead to SBS.

[explore common causes][50]
[All Hands Icon]

Connect With Others

No one should have to manage SBS alone. See how to connect with other people with SBS or communities
that support people affected by SBS.

[Join the SBS Community][51]

# YOUR STRENGTH IS INSIDE

Short bowel syndrome (SBS) is the result of a bowel resection, which can be a consequence of a
number of other medical conditions. Your inner strength can help you manage your SBS, and this
website also provides resources to help.

DARIO, LIVING WITH SBS

Short bowel syndrome (SBS) is the result of a bowel resection, which can be a consequence of a
number of other medical conditions. Your inner strength can help you manage your SBS, and this
website also provides resources to help.

[Plate and Cup Graphic]

SBS and Your Diet

There's no single “SBS diet.” Your personal nutritional needs will vary depending on the length and
portion of your remaining bowel. Read about how to help optimize your nutrition and hydration.

[Optimize your SBS diet][49]
[Intestine Icon]

Precursors to SBS

Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis (UC), and other conditions sometimes require bowel resection
surgery, which may lead to SBS. Learn about the most common conditions that can lead to SBS.

[explore common causes][50]
[All Hands Icon]

Connect With Others

No one should have to manage SBS alone. See how to connect with other people with SBS or communities
that support people affected by SBS.

[Join the SBS Community][51]

Transitions of Care

**G.U.T**
Gain Understanding of Transitions:
A Guide to Key Milestones in Short Bowel Syndrome (SBS)

This guide aims to help improve understanding and increase awareness of the important considerations
during these transitions.

[Discover the Transitions][52]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Understanding Medical Terminology

Healthcare terminology can be confusing. Understanding the differences between syndromes, disorders,
and diseases is crucial for better comprehension of medical conditions.

### Symptom

A symptom is a subjective indication of a disease or condition as perceived by the patient, such as
pain or fatigue.

Examples: Headache, fatigue, nausea
Our Focus

### Syndrome

A syndrome is a group of symptoms that collectively indicate or characterize a disease, disorder, or
abnormal condition.

Examples: Down syndrome, Marfan syndrome

### Disorder

A disorder is an abnormality of function in an organism or a disruption to the normal structure or
functioning of cells, tissues, or organs.

Examples: Anxiety disorder, Bipolar disorder

### Disease

A disease is a particular abnormal condition that negatively affects the structure or function of
all or part of an organism.

Examples: Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease

## Care and Support

Syndromes don't just affect individuals, they touch families, friends, and entire communities.
Here's how you can provide care, comfort, and confidence.

### Emotional Support

significant difference.

### Advocate

Speak up for better healthcare, accessibility, and inclusion. Every voice strengthens the community
of support.

### Connect Resources

Share information about support groups, financial assistance, and specialized care providers in your
community.

### Disease

A disease is a particular abnormal condition that negatively affects the structure or function of
all or part of an organism.

Examples: Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease

## Care and Support

Syndromes don't just affect individuals, they touch families, friends, and entire communities.
Here's how you can provide care, comfort, and confidence.

### Emotional Support

Listen without judgment and acknowledge feelings. Simple presence can mean everything during
difficult times.

### Practical Assistance

Help with daily tasks, transportation to medical appointments, or preparing meals can make a
significant difference.

### Advocate

Speak up for better healthcare, accessibility, and inclusion. Every voice strengthens the community
of support.

### Connect Resources

Share information about support groups, financial assistance, and specialized care providers in your
community.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

differentiated medicines for the future.

different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
